$schema_note: Machine-readable companion to bonsai2-floor.md. Every number carries a provenance tag: MEASURED (this machine, date given), PUBLISHED (source URL), ESTIMATE (arithmetic on tagged inputs, formula in `estimate_method`), UNMEASURED (no evidence; the tier is a placeholder the installer must confirm on-device before it promises a speed).

model_family.publisher: PrismML (prism-ml on Hugging Face; PrismML-Eng on GitHub)

bonsai2.note: Bonsai 2 ships at ONE size. The base is Qwen3.8-27B (GGUF arch `qwen35`, 64 layers, hybrid gated-DeltaNet with full attention every 4th layer, 262,144 training context). Anything smaller in the Bonsai catalogue is the earlier Bonsai (1-bit) or Ternary Bonsai (1.58-bit) generation.

bonsai2.kv_cache_note: PUBLISHED (atomic.chat guide, consistent with the hybrid layout: 16 full-attention layers x 4 KV heads x 256 dims x 2 x fp16). q8_0 KV halves it. 8K ~0.5 GB, 32K ~2 GB, 64K ~4 GB, 128K ~8 GB, 262K ~16 GB at fp16.

bonsai1_ternary.note: Ternary-Bonsai-{size}-gguf, Qwen3 bases, 1.58 bpw, 32K YaRN context. The 4B on this machine (Ternary-Bonsai-4B-PQ2_0.gguf, 1,025 MiB) is this generation. Candidate for the sub-floor local option; see decision D1 in bonsai2-floor.md.
bonsai1_ternary.provenance: PUBLISHED prism-ml org listing + MEASURED GGUF metadata 2026-09-30

runtime.required_build: PrismML fork of llama.cpp, branch `prism` (prism-v7 line), release prism-b10658 or newer
runtime.stock_llama_cpp: REFUSES ggml types 142/143 (issue https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/29058, open). Ollama and LM Studio cannot load them. A `Q2_0` file on a stock build loads silently and outputs gibberish (no Hadamard activation transform).

flags_gpu: -b 4096 -ub 2048 when VRAM allows (prompt processing 370 -> 467 tok/s on a 16K prompt, MEASURED 2026-09-18)
--kv-unified -np 2 so background probes do not queue behind a chat turn

friday_desktop_footprint_mib.provenance: ESTIMATE: Python server plus tray plus browser tab; the installer measures its own RSS and replaces this

apple_unified_usable_fraction.provenance: PUBLISHED guidance (atomic.chat) matching macOS wired-memory limits; installer measures

estimate_method.decode_tok_s: 0.7 * memory_bandwidth_gb_s / 5.5 for CPU and unified-memory tiers (decode is bandwidth-bound; 5.5 GB is the PTQ1_0 weight traffic per token excluding the embedding row; 0.7 is the achieved fraction the community AVX2 kernels reached on single-channel DDR5). GPU tiers are interpolated between PUBLISHED L4 (32.1), RTX 4090 (91.1), RTX 5090 (120.5) and MEASURED RTX 4070 (30-36) by memory bandwidth.
estimate_method.prompt_tok_s: CPU: ~2x decode on AVX2 (PUBLISHED 16 tok/s vs 8.3 decode on issue #196). GPU: PUBLISHED PP512 figures.
estimate_method.seat_mib: weights_mib + kv_mib(context, q8_0 where GPU) + compute_buffer_mib (400 at -ub 512, 1200 at -ub 2048) + 630 mmproj only when vision is on.

floor.name: APPLICATION FLOOR (Friday's published minimum)
floor.statement: The lowest hardware that runs Bonsai 2 27B PTQ1_0 well enough for Friday's core loop: 16 GB RAM, x86-64 with AVX2 and at least 4 physical cores (6 recommended), dual-channel memory, 20 GB free disk, Windows 10/11 64-bit, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon (16 GB unified), or Linux x86-64/arm64. Any discrete GPU with 8 GB VRAM or more lifts the machine into a GPU tier regardless of RAM class.
floor.why_16gb: Windows: 6,144 OS reserve + 1,500 Friday + 5,672 weights + 512 KV (8K, fp16) + 400 compute = 14,228 MiB of 16,384. 8 GB machines cannot hold the weights beside the OS at all (5,672 + 6,144 > 8,192 before Friday runs). 12 GB machines hold it only with nothing else open; they are NOT the floor because a browser tab pushes the weights to the page file and decode falls below 1 tok/s.
floor.core_loop_definition: One spoken or typed turn that calls one tool and answers in under 60 seconds after the first turn of a session, with the tool registry trimmed to the CPU profile (tool_selector top-12, ~2K tokens) so prompt processing, not decode, stays inside the budget.
floor.prompt_cost: The full registry is ~8.6K tokens (services/model_seat_gate.py GATE_NUM_CTX comment). At the floor's ~16 tok/s prompt rate that is ~9 minutes cold; with the CPU profile's trimmed registry (~2K tokens) it is ~2 minutes once per session and seconds per turn afterwards with the prompt cache. This, not tokens per second, is what makes CPU-only viable or not.
floor.below_floor_behaviour: See bonsai2-floor.md §6: Friday says which reserve failed, in numbers, offers the cloud path per amendment A6, and (decision D1) optionally the Ternary Bonsai 4B/1.7B local option with its quality honestly stated.

first_setup_rule: ONLY Bonsai 2 27B is suggested at first setup, at the packing and context the tier picks. Gemma, Qwen and every other local family remain fully supported by explicit choice and are never refused (the seat gate is a no-op by maintainer decision).
knock_on: FridayWeaver-2 trains on Bonsai 2 (Friday-Models); the E2B/Gemma lineage stops at FridayWeaver-1.
